nextStoryContext: US-017 added docs/recovery-runbook.md, the operator playbook for a stuck loop: a canonical-files table (.claude/cam-loop.local.md, .claude/.cam-worker-pane, .claude/.cam-worker-<US>.session, .claude/.cam-worker-out-<uuid>.log, .claude/cam-worker-events.jsonl, .claude/.cam-supervisor.lock) plus five scenarios (a) stuck supervisor -> find pid in cam-loop.local.md, cam stop, cam resume; (b) orphaned worker pane -> cam stop/cam resume or tmux -L cam respawn-pane -k -t <pane>; (c) partial story -> re-run gates, flip prd.json passes:true, commit; (d) stale .cam-supervisor.lock -> auto-taken-over by next cam next, rm only when pid dead; (e) read .claude/cam-worker-events.jsonl. All tmux commands use -L cam; no em-dashes. Reference facts: cam stop SIGTERMs the supervisor pid + removes the state file + kills the project tmux session (does NOT remove the lock); cam resume is the 4-mode recovery. All non-operator stories (US-001..US-017) now pass. The ONLY remaining story is US-018 (requires:operator: real E2E with real claude sessions, screencaps). The branch is ready for the review cycle (prd.review.lastVerdict is unset). NOTE: US-015/016/017 were implemented directly in a Claude Code session (no live -L cam worker pane in this checkout), not via dispatched headless workers; no .cam-worker-US-0{15,16,17}.session markers exist.
